title: Fundamentals of Density Functional Theory
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées)
field: Mathematics and computational physics (density functional theory)
level: Master's students, doctoral students and early-career researchers
about: CIMPA holds a research school, Fundamentals of Density Functional Theory, at the Technical University of Kenya in Nairobi, Kenya, from 28 June to 9 July 2027. Applications are made through CIMPA; the deadline is 28 February 2027.
requirements: See the official CIMPA school page for eligibility
